description: This file contains internal function prototypes for the Dslh Object Record component, related to DSL Home Model implementation, including object and variable record management, parameter access, change verification, and child object management.

methods.name: DslhObjroSetDslhObjEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity object for the Dslh Object Record.

methods.name: DslhObjroSetLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name for the object record.

methods.name: DslhObjroSetFullName
methods.description: Sets the full name for the object record.

methods.name: DslhObjroDestroy
methods.description: Destroys the object record, releasing resources.

methods.name: DslhObjroReset
methods.description: Resets the object record to its initial state.

methods.name: DslhObjroPopulateObjRecords
methods.description: Populates object records within the object.

methods.name: DslhObjroPopulateVarRecords
methods.description: Populates variable records within the object.

methods.name: DslhObjroParamValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies that a parameter's value has changed.

methods.name: DslhObjroChildObjectCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a child object.

methods.name: DslhObjroChildObjectRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a child object.

methods.name: DslhObjroPopulateObjRecordByName
methods.description: Populates an object record specified by name.

methods.name: DslhObjroDeleteObjRecordByName
methods.description: Deletes an object record specified by name.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetObjRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the count of object records.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetObjRecord
methods.description: Retrieves an object record by name.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetObjRecord2
methods.description: Retrieves an object record via token chain.

methods.name: DslhObjroAddObjRecord
methods.description: Adds a new object record.

methods.name: DslhObjroDelAllObjRecords
methods.description: Deletes all object records.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetVarRecordCount
methods.description: Gets the count of variable records, optionally excluding hidden ones.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetVarRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a variable record by name.

methods.name: DslhObjroAddVarRecord
methods.description: Adds a new variable record.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetTotalParamNumber
methods.description: Returns total number of parameters, with options for source and inclusion.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetAllParamValues
methods.description: Gets all parameter values into an array.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetAllParamInfos
methods.description: Gets info about all parameters.

methods.name: DslhObjroGetAllParamAttribs
methods.description: Gets attributes of all parameters.

methods.name: DslhObjroSetAllParamAttribs
methods.description: Sets attributes for all parameters.

methods.name: DslhObjroVerifyChanges
methods.description: Verifies if there are changes to parameters, returning the fault parameter if any.

methods.name: DslhObjroCommitChanges
methods.description: Commits pending changes.

methods.name: DslhObjroCommitChanges2
methods.description: Alternative commit changes method.

methods.name: DslhObjroCancelChanges
methods.description: Cancels any pending changes.

methods.name: DslhObjroAddChildObject
methods.description: Adds a child object with a new instance number.

methods.name: DslhObjroDelChildObject
methods.description: Removes a specified child object.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqIsParamUpdated
methods.description: Checks if a parameter has been marked as updated.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqClearParamUpdated
methods.description: Clears the updated flag for a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValue
methods.description: Retrieves the SLAP_VARIABLE value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueString
methods.description: Retrieves the string value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueInt
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueUint32
methods.description: Retrieves the Uint32 value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueBool
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueUint32Array
methods.description: Retrieves the Uint32 array value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueUcharArray
methods.description: Retrieves the Uchar array value of a parameter.

methods.name: DslhObjroRvqGetParamValueHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the handle value of a parameter.
